data.body:
Operator decision (2026-08-19): CLOSING — requirement folded into the RP-03 tickets that perform the work.

This ticket existed to protect the pre-observation repair boundary during an extraction of
`reconcile.py` that had not yet happened. Keeping it standalone had a structural flaw: a guard
ticket that lands AFTER the extraction can only detect a break, not prevent one — and the failure
mode here is silent (the repair still runs and writes correct-looking bytes when mis-ordered).

The invariant, its rationale, the two guard tests, and all five acceptance criteria have therefore
been copied verbatim into the descriptions of the two tickets that will actually touch
`reconcile.py`:
  - `diamond-flavoured-esok` (3350-90b1-2651-4c50) — RP-03 S5
  - `postmodern-tangled-mollusk` (0f5d-2a24-91d2-4148) — RP-03 S5 T2
A cross-cutting note was also recorded on the RP-03 epic (`unfearful-dejected-verdin`) so the epic
and its children stay consistent with each other and with the invariant.

Nothing is lost by closing this: the requirement is now enforced at the point of change rather than
tracked adjacent to it. No code change was made under this ticket.
